# Command line

`flightdeck` is one program: the terminal dashboard, the daemon that keeps its state current, the link to Jira, Slack and Trello, and the job runner. `flightdeck help <command>` prints a command's own options.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `tui` | The live dashboard (the default when no command is given) |
| `attach` | The live dashboard; the same as `tui` |
| `status` | Collect once, write state.json and print the board (or `--json`) |
| `events` | Print the newest events (`-n`), or follow them (`-f`) |
| `demo` | Render the bundled demo state |
| `config` | Print the resolved configuration, or `--get` single keys |
| `slots` | Reclaim the slots of holders whose sessions are gone |
| `daemon` | Run the daemon that writes state.json (`flightdeckd` is this command) |
| `jira` | Jira (`flightdeck link help` lists every Jira, Slack and Trello command) |
| `slack` | Slack |
| `trello` | Trello |
| `terraform` | The public Terraform registry, read-only: providers, provider docs index, modules |
| `sync` | Refresh the Jira, Slack and Trello caches |
| `secrets` | Keychain items set by hand: `set <service>` (the value on stdin), `status`, `migrate-account` |
| `link` | The link client's other commands: `status`, `templates`, `config`, `skills`, `help` |
| `job` | Scheduled jobs: `run`, `plist`, `list`, `fingerprint`, `answer`, `bucket`, `badge` |
| `notify` | A job's notification, on the Mac and the phone: the text on stdin, `[ok\|failed\|needs-you]` |
| `plan` | The Planner: `start --project <p> --brief-file <f> [--model opus\|fable\|sonnet]` |
| `standup` | Standup: `start <project> [--count N]` reads the newest items no bucket lists |
| `monitor` | Monitors: `list`, `show <id>`, `create <id> …`, `edit <id> …`, `delete <id>`, as `monitors/<id>.md` notes |
| `accounts` | The accounts registry: `list [--tsv\|--json]`, `import [--dry-run]` (from accounts.json) |
| `inbox` | The Inbox's message states: `read [--channel <a>] [--json]`, `mark <a> <ts> <state> --by <lane>` |
| `prs` | Outstanding PRs: `scan [--json] [--fixture <file>]`, what each open PR needs (read-only) |
| `workspace` | The workspace: `init [--dry-run]` creates the layout and a git repository; `pull` fast-forwards a clean checkout to `origin/main` |
| `adapters` | The tool adapters: `status`, `uninstall [<adapter>] [--dry-run]` |
| `import` | The provider context already on the machine, used in place: `[list] [--json]`, and `adopt <tool> <skill> [--dry-run]` copies an external skill into the workspace, and `source install\|adopt <owner>/<repo> <skill>` installs a skill source's skill or prints the brief to adopt it |
| `host` | The other Macs this one reaches over ssh, from `config.toml`'s `[[hosts]]`: `list [--json]`, `check`, `install`, and the machine's own `install-daemon` and `self-init <name>` |
| `help` | Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s) |

## Jira, Slack, Trello, the Terraform registry and the Keychain

These commands are how agents and scripts reach your trackers and chat. Every write takes `--dry-run`, which still reads but writes nothing.

Text for a comment, post or description can come from a file (`--text-file`, `--description-file`, `--desc-file`): a regular UTF-8 file of at most 64 KiB. `--markdown` renders bold, emphasis, code, lists, headings and https links. A secret goes in on stdin, never as an argument: `pbpaste | flightdeck secrets set slack`.

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage, 3 refused by a rule or an allowlist, 4 a write did not read back.

### Link and sync

```text
flightdeck link status
flightdeck sync [--force] [--only slack|jira|trello|buckets]
flightdeck link templates
flightdeck link config show
flightdeck link config set (jira.oauth.clientId|slack.selfDm|slack.channels.<alias>|slack.channels.<alias>.type|identity.name|identity.githubLogin) <value> [--dry-run]
flightdeck link config set slack.channels.<alias>.prs <JSON {reviewers, mention?, repos: [{repo, base, paths?}]}> [--dry-run]
flightdeck link config set (jira.productionKeepers|slack.allowedGroupMentions) <a>[,<b>…] [--dry-run]
flightdeck link config unset (slack.selfDm|slack.channels.<alias>|slack.channels.<alias>.type|slack.channels.<alias>.prs|identity.name|identity.githubLogin|jira.productionKeepers|slack.allowedGroupMentions) [--dry-run]
flightdeck link skills fetch
flightdeck link skills source fetch <owner>/<repo> [--ref <ref>]
```

### Jira

```text
flightdeck jira auth
flightdeck jira --project <p> search --jql <jql> [--fields a,b] [--max N] [--page T]
flightdeck jira --project <p> get <KEY> [--comments N]
flightdeck jira --project <p> transition <KEY> --to <status> [--dry-run]
flightdeck jira --project <p> comment <KEY> (--template <id> [--var k=v]... | --text <t> | --text-file <f>) [--markdown] [--dry-run]
flightdeck jira --project <p> create --type <T> --summary <S> [--description <D> | --description-file <f>] [--markdown] [--priority <P>] [--label <L>]... [--assignee <id>] [--reporter <id>] [--dedupe-text <X>] [--parent <KEY>] [--dry-run]
flightdeck jira --project <p> edit <KEY> [--priority <P>] [--assignee <id>] [--add-label <L>]... [--remove-label <L>]... [--parent <KEY>] [--description <D> | --description-file <f>] [--markdown] [--dry-run]
flightdeck jira --project <p> link --inward <KEY> --outward <KEY> --type <name> [--dry-run]
flightdeck jira --project <p> projects
flightdeck jira --project <p> statuses [--key <KEY>]
flightdeck jira --project <p> boards [--key <KEY>]
flightdeck jira --project <p> board-permissions [--key <KEY>]
```

### Slack

```text
flightdeck slack read <channel> [--since <ts>] [--limit N] [--include-own]
flightdeck slack thread <channel> <ts> [--limit N]
flightdeck slack post <channel> (--text <t> | --text-file <f> | --template <id> [--var k=v]...) [--markdown] [--thread <ts>] [--unfurl] [--dry-run]
flightdeck slack react <channel> <ts> --emoji <name> [--dry-run]
flightdeck slack channels
flightdeck slack users
flightdeck slack dm <user-id> [--dry-run]
flightdeck slack file <file-id>
```

### Trello

```text
flightdeck trello --project <p> lists [--tsv]
flightdeck trello --project <p> cards [--tsv]
flightdeck trello --project <p> card <card>
flightdeck trello --project <p> comment <card> (--text <t> | --text-file <f>) [--dry-run]
flightdeck trello --project <p> move <card> --to <list> [--dry-run]
flightdeck trello --project <p> create --list <list> --name <name> [--desc <d> | --desc-file <f>] [--top] [--label <L>] [--dedupe-text <X>] [--dry-run]
flightdeck trello --project <p> boards
flightdeck trello --project <p> create-board (--name <n> | --name-file <f>) [--list <extra>... | --lists-file <f>] [--dry-run]
flightdeck trello --project <p> close-board <board> [--dry-run]
```

### Terraform registry

```text
flightdeck terraform providers search <name> [--limit N] [--tsv]
flightdeck terraform provider <namespace/name> [--version <v>] [--tsv]
flightdeck terraform modules search <query> [--provider <p>] [--limit N] [--tsv]
flightdeck terraform module <namespace/name/provider> [--version <v>]
```

### Keychain items

```text
flightdeck secrets status
flightdeck secrets set (jira|jira-oauth|slack|trello|trello-key|pushover-token|pushover-user|claude-job-token.<label>)
flightdeck secrets migrate-account --from <account> [--dry-run]
```
